description:
Secure remote access and support.

TeamViewer is a comprehensive, remote access, remote control and remote support solution that works with almost every desktop and mobile platform, including Windows. It lets you remote in to computers or mobile devices located anywhere in the world and use them as though you were there.
New Features
- The TeamViewer Client and Host 64‑bit MSI packages for ARM‑based Windows devices are now available for download through the TeamViewer Remote rollout setup.
- Device groups created by users with Tensor or TeamViewer ONE licenses are now managed at the company level by default. When enabled in Admin Settings, administrators have full visibility into all device groups across the organization and can edit them regardless of who created them, preventing loss of access due to user offboarding.

Improvements
- User groups can now be granted the Conditional Access permissions “Request access” and “Accept access requests” for pre‑approved access to devices and device groups.
- AI‑driven Tia Troubleshooting is now available for connections to managed macOS devices. Tia can perform live diagnostics and execute approved remediation actions during remote support sessions, helping identify root causes and resolve issues more efficiently.
- The Conditional Access session workflow has been improved. Users can now join a session only after the remote participant has connected and the session is online. The session creation experience has also been simplified by removing session start options.

Bugfixes
- Fixed a bug that could cause TeamViewer to quit unexpectedly.
- Fixed a bug that caused online or sleeping devices to appear when the Basic Devices view was filtered to show offline devices only.
- Fixed a bug in Filebox that allowed files without an extension to be opened. This could result in incorrect file handling if a file with the same name already existed on the remote device.
- Fixed multiple Path Traversal issues leading to Local Privilege escalation. (Security Bulletin: TV-2026-1010).
- Fixed a Race Condition leading to Local Privilege escalation. (Security Bulletin: TV-2026-1010)
- Fixed an Improper Access Control leading to Remote Code Execution. (Security Bulletin: TV-2026-1010).
